name: Clone
description: Blocking splits off a clone of you, sharing your strength.
details:
Your block no longer blocks (no bubble, no block effects). Instead it splits you in two: your health, damage and block stats (not the cooldown) are halved, and a clone appears with the same halved stats and all your gun effects. Each new clone halves you again (up to 2 clones at once), until the round ends.

When a clone dies, its share isn't lost: the nearest of your remaining bodies (you or another clone) gets back 80% of what that clone took. Example: you split to 50% / 50%; your clone dies; you go back up to 90%.

If you die while a clone is up, you take over the clone instead. Phoenix Protocol only saves your last body.
